chars.H: HAMZA: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers, a short black beard drawn on his round white face.
chars.O: OMNIA: a young woman wearing a long-sleeved bright red blazer over a white blouse, long black trousers, a gold ring on her finger, a red headband on her round white head.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. HAMZA and OMNIA sit on the sofa. OMNIA leans very close to HAMZA with a flirty smile, HAMZA leans away, tense and uneasy, sweat drop on his head.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. HAMZA jumps up from the sofa, both hands raised to say stop, shocked face. OMNIA still sitting, surprised, her blazer pulled off one shoulder (fully dressed in blouse).

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. HAMZA standing, angry and confused, arms spread asking 'what are you doing?'. OMNIA sitting on the sofa looking up at him, offended.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. OMNIA stands and pulls HAMZA by the hand toward her, smiling insistently; HAMZA resists, turning his head away, eyes closed.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. HAMZA stands firm, pointing a finger, serious face, explaining. OMNIA in front of him with arms crossed, frowning and annoyed.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. OMNIA shouts furiously at HAMZA with her mouth wide open and fists clenched, angry lines around her head; HAMZA steps back, stunned.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. OMNIA points at HAMZA mockingly, rolling her eyes, contempt on her face; HAMZA stands silent and hurt.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Living room of a modern apartment in Casablanca at night, beige sofa, low coffee table, TV glowing blue, Moroccan cushions and a lantern lamp. OMNIA grabs her handbag from the sofa, turning her back to HAMZA, angry; HAMZA reaches out a hand, worried.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Entrance hallway of the same Casablanca apartment at night. OMNIA walks out through the open front door into the dark stairwell, angry; a small gold engagement ring lies on the floor near HAMZA, who stands frozen in shock looking at it.
